messages:
avi: Quick thread: propose a 'saved query lineage' view in console. Show history of routing hints, model preview snapshots, and a one-click revert for routing metadata only. Useful when rollouts change effective model and dashboards break.

marco: Strong yes. Ops often gets paged when a saved view flips model. Lineage should show (time, who changed hint, preferred_model_hint, effective_model_at_time, preview_sample_id).

chen: backend note: we currently version saved_query content but not the routing hints separately. If we store routing hints in a separate versioned resource (saved_query_routing_hints_vX) we can keep an append-only changelog and compute diffs cheaply.

tara: UX: in the saved query details show a compact timeline bar at top: dots for edits, hover to show snapshot mini-preview (model pills + cost estimate). Click a historical dot to open a side panel with full snapshot and "revert routing hints" button. Keep revert behind an "are you sure" and record audit.

avi: small API sketch: GET /api/v2/saved_queries/:id/lineage -> returns a flat list of stringified rows: ["v12|2026-03-10T12:00Z|maria|hint=redwood/gpt-4o-small|effective=redwood/gpt-4o-base|sample=s-123"]  (we'll stringify with pipe separators).

marco: prefer pipes over nested objects so console can render quickly. Also return a latest_preview_id field as string so UX can fetch expanded telemetry lazily.

chen: revert API: POST /api/v2/saved_queries/:id/revert_routing_hint {"version":"v12","actor":"ui"} -> returns status string and new_preview_generation_id. We'll enforce RBAC and require review if revert crosses org_budget_threshold.

tara: show small indicators when revert would increase projected monthly cost. Tooltip: "Reverting to this hint increases projected cost by ~23% based on last 30d usage." If increases >50% block revert behind billing-admin approval.

avi: telemetry: lineage entries should attach preview_sample_id and preview_generation_id so post-revert we can measure divergence and user impact. Emit metric saved_query.lineage_revert_count.

marco: caching: lineage list is cheap; don't call routing simulator for each item. Only fetch expanded preview on demand. Cache per saved_query lineage for 10m and invalidate on any routing_hint write.

chen: storage: append-only routing hint table with columns saved_query_id, version_id, actor, serialized_hint (string), created_at, preview_sample_id. Good for audit and simple queries.

tara: tiny UX edgecases: if a saved query was autosaved (session autosave) mark those dots differently; allow filter by actor and by 'model change' events only.

ux-bot: Feature flag "saved-query-lineage" created (default OFF in prod).

avi: next steps: chen + marco to draft API contract and DB migration; tara to mock timeline bar + revert modal; i'll write acceptance criteria and RBAC matrix. We'll sync Thurs.

avi: also add a small note to release checklist: revert actions must always create an audit record and trigger a notification to the query owner.

avi: thanks all.
